blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Read safely

blocks.text: The safe call skips length on null. Its null result is replaced by 0.
Set name to "Asha" and predict its length.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A safe call may return null, so handle that result too.
